beginner: Use familiar words, explain technical terms, and walk through the idea step by step. Use a short example only when its provenance allows it; sourced examples must be supported by a passage.
standard: Give a focused explanation of the main idea and relevant relationships. Usually use one coherent paragraph unless the user's requested format requires more.
advanced: Explain mechanisms, assumptions, limitations and derivations where relevant and supported. Use precise terminology and equations when useful. Avoid padding; more depth does not require a different model.
